description.text: Certificate Granting Students are required to complete the curriculum, fullfill the designated number of credits, complete the master thesis and defend of it. Successful graduates will receive a graduation certificate along with the degree

duration.text: The Control Theory and Control Engineering at Harbin Engineering University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5069 USD/per year ￥ 36500 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3 or above 6. Two recommendation letters(optional) From professor,associate professor or equivalents

requirements.text: 1.Foreign citizens, in good health. 2.A Bachelor Degree in related courses. 3.language proficiency: TOFEL 550 or more, or IELTS 6.0 or more, or provide other Engslish proficiency certificate (naive speakers needn’t submit the English proficiency certificate).
